how: Halo: CE player network record (0x4C bytes, native/botcore.cpp add_bot: a copy of player 0's +0x84, then these bytes laid over it). Decoded live Oct 24 on Battle Creek (free for all): +0x44 armor colour (3 turned the suit blue, seen; the local player's was 1), 18 colours (MCC's CE list). The record also holds the service tag (+0x20) and the player's Xbox id (+0x3C), which botcore sets per bot. CE's original customization is the colour alone; MCC's visor colour IS in it: +0x46 (live Oct 26 on Battle Creek: the local player's 0x8B wore a dark visor, 0x8E a magenta one, 0x87 the classic orange-gold): its value is the visor's place in MCC's list (Data/UI/unlockdb.xml: H1S2_VISOR_DEFAULT first at 0x87, then Bronze, Silver, Platinum, Obsidian (the local player's), Trippy, Rainbow, Purple Pastel ...; 31 visors, 0x87-0xA5). Original: the default visor only (Oct 26: visors are not original content); Modern: any of the 31. Weapon / vehicle skins not decoded; no armor effects.
